## Briefing
title: Payment messages from Square reach your booking portal faster
outcome: Your booking portal now runs next to its database in London. Before the move, two payment messages from Square on 6 October took 13 and 15 seconds to process.

notes.example/site-1#655: Fixed how your site tracks when people click to book, so you can now see which pages send the most bookings to Square, and sped up analytics tracking on your journal articles so Google counts those visits properly.
notes.example/site-1#662: Your opening animation now loads faster on all devices, especially phones and tablets, so visitors see your hero right away instead of waiting for a curtain to fade.
notes.example/site-1#668: Your website and booking portal are back online and working after the hosting issue took them down.
notes.example/site-1#673: Your client form uploads now work properly again without needing manual review.
notes.example/site-1#676: Made your treatments page load faster on phones by removing an image that wasn't being shown there.
notes.example/site-1#679: When you publish changes in Sanity, your website now picks them up straight away instead of waiting up to 24 hours.
notes.example/site-1#680: Moved your website and checkout to run next to your database in London, so Square's payment notifications now complete in under 3 seconds instead of 13 or 15 seconds.
notes.example/site-1#686: Rebuilt your morning finance email to show only the top three things that need your attention, with everything else listed briefly below, so you can scan it in seconds instead of scrolling through dozens of headings and old receipts.
